description:
Create a theatrical lighting section view drawing in LibreCAD (units: mm). 

1. Draw a stage floor line from (0,0) to (15000,0) on layer 'ARCHITECTURE'.
2. Draw a lighting pipe (circle, radius 24mm) centered at (2000, 5500) on layer 'RIGGING'.
3. Draw a lighting beam focused from the pipe to the floor, projecting to the right (positive X direction).
   - The center line of the beam should be angled 45 degrees down from horizontal (Standard CAD angle: 315 degrees or -45 degrees).
   - The fixture has a 36-degree beam angle (18 degrees on each side of the center line).
   - Draw the two beam edge lines on layer 'BEAM' starting from the pipe center and extending to the floor line (y=0).
4. Add a dimension measuring the width of the light pool (distance between the two points where the beam edges hit the floor) on layer 'DIMENSIONS'.

Save the drawing as '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/beam_study.dxf'.
